title: A Private Dinner Invitation
description: Vael Dracos did not call directly. His assistant called. The invitation is to a private dinner at his Amber District townhouse, described as 'a conversation about the Republic's economic direction.' Men like Vael don't extend private invitations without something specific to offer.

title: Constitutional Draft — Economic Provisions
description: The property rights and economic regulation articles are entering markup. Vael's consortium has submitted a forty-page legal analysis. Theron has submitted three pages in response. Both are being read by the same committee members.

title: Budget Allocation — Third Quarter Framework
description: With the convention dragging into its second month, revenue projections are softening. Vostane needs to adjust the fiscal framework before the quarterly report goes to parliament.

title: Foreign Delegations — Preliminary Soundings
description: Both Stellamere and Petravar embassies have requested informal meetings. Not official state visits — 'cultural exchanges.' Vyktor says both are testing what a post-constitution Veltria looks like to their strategic planners.

title: Border Situation — Numbers Update
description: The Interior Ministry's weekly border report shows the crossing rate accelerating. The camps at Ondra are at eighty percent capacity. Winter is six weeks away.

title: Black Smoke on the Eastern Border
description: Vyktor has been standing for forty minutes. Morivask has oil. Tyvaren wants it.
